messages:
Priya: Heads-up — canary for the gateway rollout is spiking 503s in eu-west-1. Alerting and autoscaling kicked but we're still seeing errors.
Alex: Oof. Is this localized to the canary only or hitting stable nodes too?
Priya: So far it's the canary set and a small number of new pods. Ops tracing shows DB connection queuing from an indexing batch.
Sara: Hold all releases touching gateway-config and related feature flags. Do not promote canaries.
deploy-bot: PAUSE: release-queue 98765 paused by @Sara (reason: incident eu-west-1-db-surge). To resume: `deploy-bot resume 98765`. See /deploy/logs/98765.
Maya: Ops confirms we can safely demote canaries. Full prod rollback needs change-window approval, but we can pin queue to previous stable version for now.
Lee: Proposed action: pin upcoming release to v2.3.0 (rollback demote v2.3.1 canaries), delay change window by 3h, and run a smoke in eu-west-1 before any resume.
Alex: Agree. @Maya can you perform the demote and post the exact commands so eng can reproduce?
Maya: Demote done. Commands ran: `deployctl demote --release 98765 --to-version v2.3.0`
Maya: Also kicked a partial rollback for the two failing canary pods.
Priya: I'll update the release notes and changelog with the incident tag and hold reason. @Sara please add the change-window shift to the release calendar.
Sara: On it. Added tag `on-hold:eu-west-1-db-surge` and updated release calendar. ETA 10m.
Alex: We should also attach a short rollback checklist to the release notes: which services, db migrations to revert (if any), and monitoring runbook links.
Priya: Adding runbook link and checklist now. snippet: ```Rollback checklist:
- demote canary (deployctl demote ...)
- pin queue to v2.3.0
- run smoke script: scripts/smoke-eu-west.sh
- monitor 30m
```
Lee: Suggest controlled resume policy if things look stable: canary -> 1% for 15m, then 5% for 30m. SRE to watch error budget.
Maya: Ops has removed the heavy indexing batch; DB latency dropped ~60%. We'll monitor 20m and report.
deploy-bot: QUEUE UPDATE: 98765 demoted -> pinned v2.3.0. Pause note appended.
Priya: Created follow-up ticket INF-4321 to track reschedule and post-incident rollout plan: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321
Sara: Release calendar shifted +3h; notify stakeholders (CS and Product) with the new window. Sent update to #product-notify. :mailbox_with_mail:
Alex: If we have no regressions after 30m, propose a controlled canary like Lee suggested and continue. If not, we'll extend the hold and plan a pre-approved rollback window.
Lee: I'll update the runbook with the exact demote/resume commands and the smoke checklist, PR incoming.
Priya: Release notes updated: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2.3.x — added incident section and pinned version.
Alex: Thanks all. I'll follow up with a short post-incident blameless note after the incident wrap. Keeping this thread pinned for coordination.
